family_title_en: Identify the irregular past tense II

stages.ix_title: Identify the irregular past tense II

prompt.en: Which word is the irregular past?

what_to_do.en: Tap the irregular past tense word.

stages.choice_rule: Four unique whole words. Exactly one is a Set II irregular past from the stem: blew, flew, grew, drew, threw, knew, began, rang, sang, drank, swam, hid, dug, bit, slid, hung, woke, wore, spoke, chose, drove, rode, wrote, froze, broke, built, kept, left, felt, fell, stood, sat, told, heard, caught. Never key Set I pasts: went, saw, ate, came, had, said, did, got, made, took, gave, found, ran, was, were. Three distractors from the stem or allowed list: a noun or describing word, the present-tense mate, and or a regular -ed past. Shuffle answer_index. One tap.

gold_items.stem: The children sang a loud song.
The teacher began and then clapped.

roots: Exactly one choice is the Set II irregular past tense from the stem. Never mark a regular -ed word as the key.
Never key Set I pasts: went, saw, ate, came, had, said, did, got, made, took, gave, found, ran, was, were.
Tier 1 distractors are nouns or describing words from the stem. Keep the past word easy to spot.
Tier 2 must include the present-tense mate of the key among the wrong choices.
Tier 3 must include a regular -ed past from the same stem so kids must reject the -ed trick.
All stem words come from roots.txt, allowed_extra_words, or <NAME>. Kid world only: school, home, food, pets, play, family, weather.
Shuffle the correct tap. Never use real names, brands, IPA, or grammar labels in stems or choices.

tier_rules.1: Stems of four to six words. The irregular past is clear. Wrong taps are nouns or describing words, not the present mate.
tier_rules.2: Stems of five to seven words. One wrong tap is the present-tense mate. Use two-syllable kid words.
tier_rules.3: Near misses. The stem also holds a regular -ed past. Kids must tap the irregular past, not the -ed word or the present mate.

vowel_change.en: This past word changes its inside letters. It does not add -ed.
vowel_change.ko: 이 과거형은 가운데 글자가 바뀝니다. -ed를 붙이지 않습니다.

not_present.en: That word is for now. Tap the word that already happened.
not_present.ko: 그 단어는 지금을 말합니다. 이미 일어난 일을 나타내는 단어를 누르세요.

not_ed_form.en: Regular past adds -ed. The irregular past does not add -ed.
not_ed_form.ko: 규칙 과거는 -ed를 붙입니다. 불규칙 과거는 -ed를 붙이지 않습니다.

not_noun.en: That word names a person or thing, not a past action.
not_noun.ko: 그 단어는 사람이나 사물의 이름이지, 과거 동작이 아닙니다.

new_word_past.en: This past word looks new. It does not add -ed.
new_word_past.ko: 이 과거형은 새 단어처럼 보입니다. -ed를 붙이지 않습니다.
